thread:
alex: Quick sweep — we need owners + due dates for postmortem actions from INC-834. I sketched a staged plan below. Please ack + claim or reassign by EOD.

alex: ACTIONS: 1) Rotate model routing cache keys (redis) -> owner? due 2d. 2) Canary for fallback model routing -> owner? due 3d. 3) Docs + test matrix for degraded-quality fallback -> owner? due 5d. 4) Kernel/driver roll for infra -> owner? ETA + risk.

maya: I can take #1 (rotate cache keys). Planning to do a rolling rotate and KV flush window. TargetThu EOD (2 business days).

diego: I'll own #2 (canary). Will add a canary config and 10% traffic for 24h. Target Mon morning.

sam: I'll pick #3 (docs + tests). Need a short review from eng-ml after draft. Target Wed COB.

jess: Blocking note: kernel/driver bump is required before we can run the canary safely. tagging infra. @riley can you confirm ETA for the driver backport?

riley: eng-infra here — we have a scheduled backport on Thu (10/14) but it may slip to Fri depending on current patch validation. I'll post status in #eng-infra; tentative ETA Thu EOD.

incidents-bot: Created Asana task INC-834-postmortem-actions #A1234 and linked thread (https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/A1234).

alex: Thanks — updated the action tracker. Small runbook snippet for the canary rollback if traffic spikes:

alex: ```
# rollback canary route
api call: POST /routing/v1/set-weight 
body: {"model":"fallback-v1","weight":0} 
# revert to stable route 
```

maya: Note: when rotating cache keys, use `cache:rotate --grace 300` so clients don't fail on short TTLs.

diego: Will wait for riley confirmation before scheduling canary. If infra slips, propose to run canary at 15% for 4h then 5% for 20h to reduce risk.

sam: Will prepare PR for docs and tests, will ping eng-ml for a quick review. PR link when ready.

jess: If kernel slips to Fri, that pushes canary to next week. Please update Asana tasks accordingly.

alex: OK — current ownership summary:
- #1 rotate cache keys -> maya -> due: Thu EOD
- #2 canary fallback routing -> diego -> due: Mon AM (pending infra)
- #3 docs + tests -> sam -> due: Wed COB
- #4 kernel backport -> riley/eng-infra -> ETA Thu EOD (may slip)

alex: If anyone needs to reassign, drop a quick reply and update Asana. I'll follow up tomorrow AM for any slips. :thumbsup:
